phases.name: Foundation build
phases.focus: Develop basic movement quality, learn proper technique, and establish a consistent weekly cadence.

phases.name: Progressive strength
phases.focus: Increase load tolerance and strength through bodyweight progression and leverage from the doorway bar.

phases.name: Strength consolidation
phases.focus: Capitalize on improved strength with higher effort sets and training density while maintaining form.

non_negotiables: Safety first: ensure doorway pull‑up bar is securely mounted and rated for the user’s bodyweight.
No dynamic spine flexion under load; maintain neutral spine throughout core and loaded movements.
Use a clear, unobstructed space; remove obstacles during training sessions.
Warm up prior to every session with 5–10 minutes of movement prep and mobility work.
Progressions must be applied conservatively; if form breaks, regress to easier variation.
Stop immediately if pain beyond normal muscle fatigue occurs; consult a professional if unsure.

PLAN "12-week doorway-only strength program"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public
GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Full-body strength development with minimal equipment"

PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation build" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Push training 30m "Foundational pushes":
        warmup:
          jogging_in_place 2m
          arm_circles 1m
          shoulder_stretch 1m
          push_up_prep 2m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          incline_push_up 3x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 2m
          child_pose 2m
      DAY Pull/hinge training 30m "Foundational pulls":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 2m
          scapular_retraction 1m
          thoracic_rotation 1m
        main straight_sets:
          bodyweight_row 3x6 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          door_pull_up_bar_negative 3x3 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 1m
          upper_back_stretch 1m
      DAY Leg/glute training 30m "Foundational legs":
        warmup:
          leg_m swings 1m
          hip_mobility 1m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 1m
          hamstring_stretch 1m
  PHASE "Foundation build" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Push training 32m "Technique and volume":
        warmup:
          jogging_in_place 3m
          band_stretches 2m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          incline_push_up 3x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:

          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Pull/hinge training 32m "Grip and scapular control":
